offline: These Canadian contact details are included in the app. Calling and texting require a working phone service; websites require internet access. MindGuard does not monitor emergencies or contact anyone automatically. Outside Canada, use your local emergency and crisis services.

items.title: Suicide crisis support
items.description: In Canada, call or text 9-8-8 for suicide crisis support, available 24 hours a day in English and French.

items.title: Immediate danger
items.description: If you are in immediate danger or need urgent medical support in Canada, call 9-1-1.

items.title: Mental health support
items.description: Government of Canada information about mental health support and provincial and territorial services.
